player_prompt.intro:
D akken d Player {player_id} di Connect Four.
Asekkil-ik n teskert: {symbol}.
Tablatt n uqeddis tesɛa {num_rows} tisragen d {num_cols} tislegen.
Imuren ttekkin turin timsuḍaf-nsen di yiwet n tislegen (0 ar {end_col}).
Wi yezmer ad yeqqen (timsuḍaf-ines) rebɛa n teskert s azɣar, s usfaylu, neɣ s tmuɣli itteɣ.
Di tur-ik, sekkel numru n tislekt di tiswiyin n murzeɛ ɣef wamek ad tekkiḍ.
Ula d asekkil: '[col 4]' neɣ '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Ur ttwalint ara imurar i usebter n wurar.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Tafyirt n tihri n tɣawsa. Tafyirt ittwattun: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Tafyirt n tɣawsa. Tislekt {col} ur tili ara di tɣzi.
